title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Baie-Saint-Paul, 2–4 July, 2015–2025
claims: For Baie-Saint-Paul on 2–4 July in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 16.4–32.5 °C (median 24.8 °C), daily minimum 8.9–21.2 °C (median 14.3 °C), 11 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 4 days with at least 5 mm.
The grid is Baie-Saint-Paul, not Mont-Sainte-Anne, Saint-Tite-des-Caps or the Sentier des Caps ridge.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 2–4 July; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
